summaryShort: Their growth direction presses against how freely you present yourself and enter situations.
summaryDeep: Their growth direction presses against how freely you present yourself and enter situations. The way you naturally enter situations keeps getting asked to stretch toward something less familiar. The invitation is real, and so is the fatigue of always being asked.
